title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 3. Stresses that the EU must be fully prepared to fight against mass migration, which poses a serious risk to prosperity and undermines the public security and social stability of the Member States, and also to fight against international organised crime and international terrorism, supported and controlled by states or organisations that represent a threat to the security of the Member States and their citizens;
